context:
This item asks you to accept a cost. It does not block the PR.
Goal: a cloud session gets main's new hooks mid-session, so a stale guard stops letting through what main refuses.
Problem (rule): the freshness hook (hooks/stale_install.py:123) runs one `git ls-remote` on every cloud prompt, and reruns the installer when main moved. That is a watch that is not one of the three ruled timer exceptions, and your rule says watching must cost less than what it watches (outcomes-mechanize-rules). The cost is unmeasured. The PR carries no decision text and no cost test for it. Only you can accept a per-prompt network read.
Based on (premise): the hook's docstring states one ls-remote per prompt and nothing more; no measurement exists (lane cloud-hooks-stale-copy, relayed by the coordinator 03:12 CST Nov 15, not read by triage).
Based on (read): triage read PR 3487 on GitHub at 03:15 CST: open draft, head b6b1d652ac26, mergeable clean, base ef36c765df2d, 13 files. It replaces PR 3020 (closed 02:53 CST, unmerged).
Departs from: main — adds a per-prompt network read in cloud sessions.
Who recommends what: the coordinator and the lane both recommend a. The star is theirs, not yours. The lane builds the decision text and the cost test only after you pick.
Meanwhile: PR 3487 is not held on this answer; it stays a draft in the merge queue.
